cases.description: Two 503s then 201: three requests with the same Idempotency-Key and body; sleeps 250, 500 with random 0.5
Each retry draws a new random value
max_retries 3: four attempts, then the last error is thrown
Backoff is capped at 20 s before jitter: with random 0.5 the 7th delay is 10000
429 with Retry-After: 2 waits exactly 2000 ms (no jitter)
Retry-After above 60 s: no retry, RateLimitError with retry_after
Retry-After as an HTTP-date is measured against the SDK clock (now 12:00:00 → 12:00:03 = 3000 ms)
An unparseable Retry-After is ignored: normal backoff
A reset connection is retried with the same key
A timeout is retried with the same key and body
links.create retries reuse its random UUID v4 key
